_note: Pruned to the facts a segment table is built from: revenue, operating income, assets, long-lived assets, capital expenditure, depreciation and amortisation, for periods ending on or after 2023-01-01, undimensioned or carried on the business-segments, geographical, consolidation-items or product-or-service axes. The cross-dimensioned and product-or-service rows are kept deliberately: Entertainment revenue is tagged once whole, again split by geography and again split third-party against intersegment, so a table that does not exclude multi-axis facts counts that segment three times. Repeated inline renderings of the same fact are collapsed; nothing else is changed.
